algorithm: SAP (Semi-Analytic Primal) solver: a custom Newton-type solver on an unconstrained convex primal reformulation of compliant contact, with analytic gradients, line search, and sparsity exploitation
headline_metric: solver speedup vs. baseline solvers at matched mean momentum error, dual-arm jar/marbles/bowl task
headline_value: SAP is 7.4x faster than Gurobi and 2.2x faster than Geodesic IPM, averaging 4 solver iterations/timestep vs. 8.3 (Geodesic IPM) and 10.1 (Gurobi) (Sec. VI-E, Fig. 21)
note_gaps: code/md is a README + pruned file tree + Python (pydrake) signatures only, no C++ SAP solver source captured, so solver internals come entirely from the paper text; the near-rigid penetration estimates (2.5e-7 m at dt=1e-3s, 2.5e-5 m at dt=1e-2s) are an analytical bound for a single point mass on a plane, not a measured penetration depth in the dual-arm grasp demo, and should not be quoted as a general Drake grasp-penetration number.
